facts.fact: The BCEAO granted Quickpay an electronic money institution licence on 3 March 2025, announced 24 March, per Agence Ecofin.

SEN.note: International transfers mentioned only as services Quickpay is able to offer, not shown in service.

facts.fact: The BCEAO licenses electronic money institutions in Senegal; Senegal had three at 31 December 2024 (Wave Digital Finance, Mobile Cash, Orange Finance Mobiles Senegal) per Agence Ecofin.

The BCEAO licensed the fintech Quickpay, a subsidiary of Edkoil group, as an electronic money institution from 3 March 2025, following Wave Digital Finance in April 2022, described as a non-bank, non-telecom licensee.

SEN.note: Account counts only, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: Senegal had three licensed electronic money institutions operating at 31 December 2024: Wave Digital Finance, Mobile Cash and Orange Finance Mobiles Senegal, per Agence Ecofin.
